prompt: I was on the Free plan last year, but I upgraded to the Pro plan back in March. Does my account currently include Pro-tier priority support?

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
I was on the Free plan last year, but I upgraded to the Pro plan back in March. Does my account currently include Pro-tier priority support?

events.reply:
I don't have any way to look up your account details, billing history, or subscription status—I only have access to a local workspace on this machine, not Anthropic's account or billing systems. So I can't confirm what plan your account is currently on or what it includes.

That said, I can offer some general guidance:

- **Check your plan status directly** in your account settings / billing page, which should show your current plan and its renewal date.
- **A Pro plan upgrade** made in March would normally remain active as long as the subscription keeps renewing and payments succeed. If a payment failed or the subscription was cancelled at some point, the account could have reverted to Free, so it's worth verifying rather than assuming.
- **Support tiers can change over time.** What "Pro-tier support" includes today may differ from what it included when you upgraded, so check the current plan comparison / support documentation for the exact entitlements.
- If the billing page is unclear or you think there's a discrepancy, contact Anthropic support (or use the in-product help/support option) and reference your account email so they can look up the specifics.

If you paste in details from your billing page, I'm happy to help you interpret them.
